schemaName: SVS German Vehicle Registration (Fahrzeugschein ZB I)
guidelines: Extract data from a German Zulassungsbescheinigung Teil I (Fahrzeugschein). Use official field codes when visible: C.1.1 Nachname, C.1.2 Vorname, C.1.3 Adresse, B Erstzulassung, E Kennzeichen, A FIN. Return null for missing fields. Dates as YYYY-MM-DD when possible. CRITICAL for firstRegistrationDate: use ONLY field B (Datum der Erstzulassung des Fahrzeugs). NEVER use field 6, NEVER use production/manufacturing date (Baudatum, Produktionsdatum, Datum zu 4), NEVER field I (Datum dieser Zulassung), NEVER field K/HU dates.

jsonSchema.description: German vehicle registration certificate (Zulassungsbescheinigung Teil I)

ownerAddressStreet.description: Street and house number from C.1.3

licensePlate.description: Official license plate / amtliches Kennzeichen (field E)

firstRegistrationDate.description: Field B only: Datum der Erstzulassung des Fahrzeugs (NOT field 6 production date, NOT field I). Format YYYY-MM-DD
